additional_info.subject: ID0433061-DC/Si-D/AT-[RVP/S4170003562] Commissioning issue CRM:00642002371
additional_info.body:
Hello Daniel,
Hope you are doing great.
As per the reported issue, we have identified a problem with the charger's fan. Please follow the steps below to proceed with troubleshooting.
This problem indicates that there might be an obstruction preventing the charger from rotating. Additionally, please inspect the wiring, as it's possible that the fans are unable to provide feedback. Consider planning for an auxiliary fan replacement to perform an on-site check; it's possible that the fan is damaged.
We need site intervention to check for the reason of the Deadlock, if any of the wire or some obstacle obstructing the fan (GQ2 and GQ3) functioning.
Regarding GQ2 Fan, we need to check for the 24V, 0V power supply to the fan and check the Output Couple QA31, Connections (continuity) at XD9.
